items.q: the house where a famous writer, philosppher and mathematician named Blaise Pascal had lived.

ctx.x: But the climax or rather the conclusion to this story is that I never saw Fred Bungie or Mike Wyatt again because they were both killed in automobile accidents, Mike in France and Fred somewhere in Germany.

Since 1956 Lily and I had been living in a small but nice rented apartment in the 6th district and we decided that it would not be a bad idea if we bought a little place of our own. We found a flat at 54 rue Monsieur le Prince (a very pretty name to my estimation) which was the house where a famous writer, philosppher and mathematician named Blaise Pascal had lived. A votive tablet is still on the front of the building.
